# Anvil

> Anvil is an open source family of developer tools for inspectable delivery work, npm dependency policy, safer Node installs, and capability-scoped runtime contracts.

The public documentation is organized by product and by task: Learn, Build, and Reference. Product status and limits are part of the documentation; do not infer production readiness from alpha surfaces.

## Start here

- [Documentation index](/docs): Search or choose a product and task path.
- [Anvil overview](/docs/overview): Understand the four product boundaries.
- [Repository map](/docs/project/repositories): See which workspace owns each surface.
- [Open source project](/docs/project/open-source): Read the project and contribution model.

## Products

- [Anvil Desktop](/docs/desktop): Local repo-aware delivery workspace.
- [Anvil Registry](/docs/registry): npm dependency ingress and deterministic policy.
- [Anvil Node Base](/docs/node-base): Safer and observed Node dependency installs.
- [Anvil Cloud](/docs/cloud): Anvil Cells, Agents, runtime contracts, and deployment adapters.

## More detail

- [Full agent guide](/llms-full.txt): Detailed Anvil Cloud implementation rules and contracts.
